acf.speaker_position: Benevolent Dictator, Cloud Operations at Tornimo.io

blocks.html:
Maciek is Cloud Operations (aka Cloud Acrobat) at Codewise. He's also open source contributor, enthusiast and evangelist supporting OWASP, Fedora Linux distro and a couple of containerization projects.

Maciej believes in chaos engineering and automation - preferably achieved in a most pythonic way. He's a true Linux nerd and a Gopher. You can catch him on Twitter @docent_net and also see his work on github/@docent-net and his personal blog/maciej.lasyk.info. Besides Maciek runs sports blog and podcast/dlugodystansowy.pl
